basis: The public task asks for the route that fits the 'overall request pattern' shown on the dashboard. While the chart title reads 'Declining Telehealth Follow-up Requests from 2012 to 2023', the plotted data clearly shows a substantial overall increase in telehealth follow-up requests, starting near 800 in 2012 and ending near 2700 in 2023. The final year-to-year drop from 2022 to 2023 is minor compared to the overall growth trend. Based on the actual data pattern representing the overall demand, the growth-response route is the most appropriate selection.
option_label: Route the record to growth-response follow-up
